scope: Source-level synthetic regression evidence for test-only account-lock subprocess isolation.

source_change.implementation: Create the fixture and exercise the complete lock lifecycle inside a separate exact-test process. Preserve parallel execution for other tests; no retries or global serialization.

original_hosted_failure.error: Result::unwrap() received AccountError::Busy at final lock reacquisition.
original_hosted_failure.status: Original failure retained; local validation does not rerun or replace this hosted release result.
original_hosted_failure.candidate_scope: Reported version-only child of the base source; original candidate was not checked out for the local reproduction.

cause_assessment.mechanism: Another test can fork while a lock descriptor is open. The child retains the same open-file description until exec or exit, so closing only the test-owned descriptors does not prove that the lock has been released. The adoption test deliberately clears CLOEXEC; even descriptors with CLOEXEC set can remain open between fork and exec.
cause_assessment.evidence: Source inspection, exact panic reproduction and serial/skip-spawn controls. No syscall trace was available.
cause_assessment.feature_scope: No default-feature-specific branch exists in the affected lock path; feature selection can change scheduling and expose the race.

parallel_accounts_suite.failure: All five reproduce the original Busy panic at accounts.rs:1550.

intermediate_adoption_only_fix.result: The same immediate post-drop lifetime assumption also affected the native OFD test. Final isolation covers that test and the equivalent permanent shared-lease contract.

sandbox_attempts.limitation: The syscall sandbox denied SO_PEERPIDFD/local IPC and prevented native fixture execution. These attempts are recorded as failed or unavailable checks, not passing validation.
sandbox_attempts.resolution: Final source tests used approved execution outside the syscall sandbox and only synthetic fixtures; installed host authentication helpers were not executed.

final_validation.environment: Fedora 44 x86_64 source-build workspace; synthetic fixtures outside the syscall sandbox.
final_validation.command_note: Cargo used a private target directory and JSON build messages for evidence collection; private absolute paths are omitted.

limits: Local source validation is separate from the failed hosted release run and subsequent hosted CI results.
These tests do not establish installed KDE behavior, enforcing SELinux acceptance, physical hardware support or independent security review.
Ignored tests were not counted as passing tests.
No real credentials, installed host authentication helpers, host PAM edits, service changes, policy loads or physical TPM operations were used.
